sizes ranged from 100 to 600 nm

aging
Particle 
dimensions increase substantially as air flow was 
decreased

range

morphologies

Conclusions
28
Ground based testing at 8 cm/s showed particle dimensions very close to the flight results
ISS Detector showed reduced detection performance for Kapton and Teflon due to the small size
STS Detector fared slightly better for Kapton and Teflon
Spacecraft 
fire conditions include an even wider array of 
materials and conditions
Spacecraft background aerosols can be quite large (false alarms)

Conclusions
29
It is improbable that a single-moment device can be sensitive across the size spectrum and resist false alarms 
Detectors that can normalize the concentration for the particle size may solve this problem
